features.quote: hotels across the street (ALL IN ONE)
features.rationale: The description labels the event ALL IN ONE and says hotels are across the street from the venue.
The event includes ten hours of workshops.

features.quote: 1 100,000% Kizomba room / 1 Salsa Bachata Fun room
features.rationale: The event has two dance rooms, one for Kizomba and one for Salsa Bachata Fun.
A named official hotel is recommended, and a festival offer rate is negotiated, but accommodation is not part of the pass.
